title: Agent Trestle ownership policy
description: Maps repository-relative path globs to the actor allowed to change them. Ownership is deliberately not a .trestle/config.json key: it is merge policy, so it lives in its own explicitly supplied document.

owners.description: Actor ID to the repository-relative globs that actor owns. Supports *, ? and **.

defaultOwner.description: Owner applied to a path no glob matches. Null means unowned.

allowUnowned.description: When false (the default) a changed path that no rule covers rejects the merge. Enabling this weakens the ownership invariant and must be deliberate.

pathStyle.description: Path interpretation for globs. Git reports repository-relative POSIX paths, so posix is the default and a literal backslash stays a filename byte.
